# Industry Corpus Manufacturing Guide

Open guide to BAAI IndustryCorpus2 manufacturing subset (trillion-token, Chinese-English bilingual, Apache-2.0).

- Repo: https://github.com/lu7897859-tech/industry-corpus-manufacturing-guide
- Source data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/BAAI/IndustryCorpus2_other_manufacturing
- Parent DOI: 10.57967/hf/3488
- License: CC0 (this guide) / Apache-2.0 (source data)

Key topics: manufacturing corpus, Chinese-English bilingual, LLM fine-tuning, LoRA, technical translation, procurement AI.
